description: This file defines a syntax highlighting mode for the CodeMirror editor tailored to the NSIS scripting language. It includes regex patterns for syntax elements such as numbers, strings, commands, conditionals, macros, variables, comments, and other language constructs, along with MIME type registration.

methods.name: defineSimpleMode
methods.description: Defines a new syntax highlighting mode for a specific language, in this case, 'nsis'.

methods.name: defineMIME
methods.description: Associates a MIME type with a syntax highlighting mode.
